subject.title: Reduce remote node bin probe churn

question: Should this PR land with a 5 second connect-time probe delay, 30 minute success cache, and 15 second to 5 minute failure backoff once branch-built macOS node proof is supplied?
rationale: Those timing windows intentionally change when remote skill eligibility updates after reconnects, failures, and local bin changes; tests show the intended mechanics, but a maintainer should own the availability tradeoff before merge.

options.title: Accept Bounded Timing After Proof
options.body: Keep the current timing windows if branch-built macOS node proof shows delayed connect probing, approval refresh, reconnect cache reuse, and failed-probe backoff behaving as intended.

options.title: Narrow The Timing Policy
options.body: Require shorter TTL/backoff or additional invalidation if maintainers want remote skill availability to track node environment changes more quickly.

options.title: Pause For Replacement
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and ask for a smaller replacement if live proof or timing consensus does not arrive.

recommendation.title: Accept Bounded Timing After Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the current timing windows if branch-built macOS node proof shows delayed connect probing, approval refresh, reconnect cache reuse, and failed-probe backoff behaving as intended.
